units.title: Money and markets
units.tagline: Start here. Learn what stocks are and how people talk about them.

nodes.title: What is money?
nodes.goal: Learn that money is a tool we swap for things we need.

nodes.title: What is a company?
nodes.goal: See how a company makes things and sells them to people.

nodes.title: What is a stock?
nodes.goal: A stock is a tiny piece of a company that you can own.

nodes.title: Warm-up round
nodes.goal: Play a quick round about money, companies and stocks.

nodes.title: What is a market?
nodes.goal: A market is a place where buyers and sellers meet.

nodes.title: Buy low, sell high
nodes.goal: Learn what profit and loss mean with a simple story.

nodes.title: Treasure chest
nodes.goal: Open a bonus chest of XP for your hard work.

nodes.title: Ticker symbols
nodes.goal: Read short stock names like AAPL, TSLA and SPY.

nodes.title: Trader short-talk
nodes.goal: Decode short words like IPO, EPS, ATH and FOMO.

nodes.title: Bulls, bears and indexes
nodes.goal: Learn what it means when people say the market is up or down.

nodes.title: Mixed practice
nodes.goal: Practice tickers, short-talk and bulls and bears.

nodes.title: Unit 1 boss
nodes.goal: Show what you know about money, stocks and markets.

units.title: Reading a chart

nodes.title: Meet TradingView
nodes.goal: See what TradingView is and how to make a free account.

nodes.title: A tour of the screen
nodes.goal: Find the symbol search, the watchlist and the layout.

nodes.goal: Learn a 0 to 100 gauge of how fast a price has moved.

nodes.goal: Learn how the bands grow and shrink with price swings.

nodes.goal: Learn why the number of shares traded matters.

nodes.goal: Learn the three-candle star patterns.

units.title: How day trading works

nodes.goal: Learn what it means to open and close a trade on the same day.

nodes.title: A day on the market
nodes.goal: Walk through pre-market, the open, midday and the close.

nodes.title: Liquidity and the spread
nodes.goal: Learn why buying costs a little more than selling.

nodes.title: Market and limit orders
nodes.goal: Learn the two most basic ways to buy and sell.

nodes.title: Place your first orders
nodes.goal: Use market and limit orders in the simulator.

nodes.title: Stop orders
nodes.goal: Learn stop and stop-limit orders that protect you.

nodes.title: Trailing, bracket, OCO
nodes.goal: Learn orders that manage a trade for you.

nodes.title: Protect a trade
nodes.goal: Place a bracket order with a stop and a target.

nodes.goal: Learn how to bet on a price falling, and why it is risky.

nodes.title: PDT rule and margin

nodes.title: Opening range and VWAP

nodes.title: Pullback, news, gap and go
nodes.goal: Study three more ideas, and how each one can fail.

nodes.title: Strategy lab
nodes.goal: Try a study idea in the simulator and see how it can fail.

nodes.goal: Trade a short session in the simulator using what you learned.

units.title: Risk management

nodes.goal: Learn the 1 percent rule and why small bets keep you in the game.

nodes.title: How many shares?

nodes.title: Size it right
nodes.goal: Use the position size helper in the simulator.

nodes.title: Risk to reward
nodes.goal: Compare what you could lose with what you could win.

nodes.goal: Learn why a stop can fill at a worse price.

units.title: News and the economy

nodes.title: Earnings reports

nodes.title: The economic calendar
nodes.goal: Find the big dates that can move the whole market.

nodes.title: The Fed and interest rates
nodes.goal: Learn what the Fed and the FOMC do.

nodes.title: CPI and jobs reports
nodes.goal: Learn two reports that people watch closely.

nodes.title: Fed day
nodes.goal: React to a simulated Fed decision.

nodes.title: Buy the rumor, sell the news

units.title: Graduation
